data.title: ML Hooks Configuration Fix - Complete Resolution
data.summary: Completed the ML data collection fix that was losing 99.6% of training data. Verified test isolation fix and resolved hook configuration conflict.

sections.Background:
## The Problem

ML data collection system was losing 99.6% of training data:
- Only 19 chats captured vs 5,000 target
- Sessions.jsonl showed no new data after Dec 27, 2025
- Hooks configured in project .claude/settings.local.json weren't running

## Root Causes Identified (Previous Session)

1. **Test Isolation Bug**: `temp_experiments_dir` fixture only patched `experiment_module`, not `metrics_module`. Tests were writing to real metrics.jsonl, polluting production data.

2. **Hook Configuration Conflict**: Global ~/.claude/settings.json had a Stop hook that was overriding/conflicting with project-level hooks in .claude/settings.local.json.

## Reference
